findings: Flood: Installing the pre-fitted doorway barrier (fit-barrier:47675206, 15-30 min) is faster than building a sandbag wall (sandbag-wall:47675206, 70-110 min) for the same modeled reduction (9 cm entry water and 10 wet boxes to 0), while moving contents (move-contents:47675206) avoids wet boxes without stopping water entry and clearing the inlet (clear-inlet:156105) lowers local water from 11 cm to 7 cm.
Flood (pump): Deploying the portable pump (portable-pump:0) reduces modeled local water from 92 cm to 0 cm in the 12 m cell using a bounded local flow-balance approximation.
Power: Deploying a pump on an existing approved backup circuit (backup-pump:47675206) reduces modeled local water at building 47675206 from 24 cm to 9 cm.

Wind: Under weak wind (5.45 m/s sustained, 7.88 m/s gusts), latching operable windows (latch-windows:47674922) eliminates 77 L of modeled indoor rain, whereas securing loose exterior items (secure-items:47674922) shows no modeled benefit (0 broken panes and 77 L indoor rain before and after).

Routes: Installing an authorized cordon (install-cordon:R12552201-0) shifts the flooded road from uncontrolled entry to blocked entry, while light debris clearance (clear-route:R12552201-0) leaves the flooded road impassable with uncontrolled entry.

Trees: Under this weak wind forcing, pruning an arborist-specified defect (prune-defect:T193357, 150-300 min) shows no modeled benefit because the tree remains standing and the road stays open in both branches.
Structure: Installing an engineer-designed support package (engineered-support:47674922, 210-420 min) shows no modeled benefit under weak wind because the facade stays in place before and after.
Model basis: All six hazard views rely on extrapolated local mechanism models reusing the same logged P50 storm and 31 flood frames rather than validated local predictions.
misleading_claims: Claiming the counterfactuals are validated local predictions, or inferring city-wide dollar savings or available specialist team counts from action roles and labor estimates.
Treating portable-pump:0 (92 cm to 0 cm) as an isolated full-city hydrodynamic rerun rather than a bounded local flow-balance approximation at a single 12 m cell.
Treating the clear-inlet:156105 reduction (11 cm to 7 cm) as an isolated marginal drain benefit or a validated estimate of avoided property damage per cleared inlet.
Crediting arbitrary barriers or assuming sandbag-wall:47675206 guarantees watertightness, when barrier benefits are conditional on assessed protection levels and proper construction.

Using Hurricane Andrew observational tree survival rates or non-specific structural failure studies to claim a causal local benefit for prune-defect:T193357 or engineered-support:47674922 in this weak-wind scenario.
Claiming quantified avoided injuries from install-cordon:R12552201-0 or route reopenings from clear-route:R12552201-0 when the road remains flooded and impassable.
Assuming backup-pump:47675206 guarantees flood control without an approved circuit and protected supporting backup power components.
